main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu grass on all-weather sand base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier venue on the NSW South Coast operated by the Moruya Jockey Club. A symmetrical 1,760m oval featuring long front and back straights linked by long, sweeping cambered turns. Its defining characteristic is a generous 400m home straight built over a well-draining sand base. The wide, sweeping layout and long run-in produce an exceptionally fair playing field where all running styles (E, P, S, C) receive a fair contest. Mid-pack stalkers ('P') and strong-finishing swoopers ('S') get ample opportunity to run down early leaders.
main_turf.post_bias: BALANCED DRAW / FAIR RUNNING SURFACE: Generous straight run-ups from starting chutes at 1000m, 1200m, and 1450m minimize barrier penalties. Inside draws (1-4) hold a minor advantage in 1000m sprints into the home bend. Beyond 1200m, barrier draw penalties are minimal — race tempo and class form dominate.

handicapping_angles.moruya_cup_january_feature: The Moruya Cup ($75k+ Showcase Handicap, January) is the feature event of the Moruya Jockey Club season. Race quality elevates significantly to NSW Country Showcase level. Upgrade horses with proven regional benchmark form from Canberra, Kembla Grange, and Goulburn (+3.0 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.sydney_and_provincial_shipper_advantage: Trainers shipping in from Sydney Metro (Warwick Farm, Randwick), Hawkesbury, Kembla Grange, Goulburn, and Canberra (e.g. Barbara Joseph & Paul Jones, Luke Pepper, Theresa Bateup, Natalie Jarvis, Matthew Dale) carry a distinct speed and class advantage over local South Coast runners.
handicapping_angles.fair_400m_home_straight_swooper_upgrade: Moruya's broad turns and long 400m home straight prevent pure front-runner locks. Do not hesitate to back strong-finishing closers ('S' and 'C' styles) with high late 400m sectionals — leaders can be run down here if early tempo is solid.
handicapping_angles.sand_base_all_weather_drainage: The sand sub-base provides excellent drainage. Even after heavy coastal rainfall, the track recovers quickly between morning and afternoon. Treat Soft 5-6 ratings as fast-playing surfaces suitable for all horse types.
handicapping_angles.nsw_country_benchmark_weight_penalty: In NSW Country Benchmark handicaps (BM58-BM74), top weights carrying 59.0kg+ face a physical stamina tax over the 400m home straight. Grant a boost to fit, well-weighted runners receiving apprentice claim relief (2kg–3kg).
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard program: 1000m, 1200m, 1300m, 1420m, 1650m, 2000m. Dedicated chutes at 1000m and 1200m.
